checkpoints.dataset_lineage: NASA Tropical Cyclone Wind Estimation Competition (GOES-16/17 Band 13 @ 10.3 µm, Himawari-8 Band 13 @ 10.4 µm; 2,500 images across 25 storm IDs; distinct from TCIR)
checkpoints.preprocessing_contract: Single-channel infrared brightness temperature crop, resized to 128x128 px, normalized with mean=[0.45] and std=[0.22]
checkpoints.output_spec: Scalar 1-minute sustained wind speed in knots (Huber regression) and 6-class auxiliary category logits

checkpoints.dataset_lineage: NASA Tropical Cyclone Wind Estimation Competition sequential temporal sequences (2,425 chronological sequences across 25 storm IDs; distinct from TCIR)
checkpoints.preprocessing_contract: Chronological sequence of T=3 infrared frames, resized to 64x64 px, normalized with mean=[0.45] and std=[0.22] (irregular satellite observation intervals matching capture timestamps)
checkpoints.output_spec: Scalar 1-minute sustained future wind intensity (knots) and normalized next-frame infrared imagery (1, 1, 64, 64)

checkpoints.architecture: VayumargTrackGRU (2-layer GRU, 96 hidden units, temporal self-attention pooling)
checkpoints.dataset_lineage: NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 North Indian Ocean historical tracks (1982-2024, 3-hourly sliding windows, 6h/12h/24h target horizons)
checkpoints.preprocessing_contract: 8-step historical trajectory sequence (24h observation window at 3h cadence) with 10 kinematic features: normalized lat, lon, dx, dy, translational speed, bearing sine/cosine, wind speed, delta wind, and temporal progression index
checkpoints.output_spec: Multi-horizon displacement vectors (dx, dy) in km and future sustained wind speeds at +6h, +12h, and +24h horizons

checkpoints.architecture: VayumargHybridTrackModel (2-layer GRU with hidden_size=64, Great-Circle Geodesic Kinematic Baseline + Bounded MLP Residual Heads)
checkpoints.dataset_lineage: NOAA IBTrACS v04r01 North Indian Ocean historical tracks with spherical geodesic residual errors (1982-2024; strictly kinematic, zero atmospheric GFS/ERA5 features)
checkpoints.preprocessing_contract: 8-step historical trajectory sequence (24h observation window at 3h cadence) with 10 kinematic features paired with baseline geodesic displacement tensor
checkpoints.output_spec: Hybrid displacement vectors combining geodesic kinematic baseline with learned residual corrections (bounded tanh) at +6h, +12h, and +24h
